items.title: Section: How the Ten Causes Work in Practice — A Single Grain of Barley

items.zh: 謂於世間種種稼穡墮諸穀數世資生物，所有種種名想言說，謂大麥、小麥、稻穀、胡麻、大小豆等。即此望彼種種稼穡，為隨說因。
items.en: Regarding the world's various crops, comprised among the grains that sustain worldly life, all the various names and designations given to them — barley, wheat, rice, sesame, and various beans — these names, with respect to the crops themselves, serve as the cause of expression.

items.zh: 如言大麥，持去、持來，若磨、若置，如是等類種種隨說。如說大麥，餘小麥等，當知亦爾。
items.en: As when one says "barley" — carrying it away, bringing it back, grinding it, or storing it — all such various forms of expression apply. Just as with barley, it should be understood that the same holds for wheat and the other grains.

items.title: The Ten Causes Applied to a Grain Crop, Completing the Illustration

items.zh: 觀待飢渴羸劣身住，觀待段食所有愛味，於彼追求、執取、受用，即說彼法為觀待因。由彼各別自種子故，種種稼穡差別而生，即說彼種子為此牽引因。地、雨等緣，能生於芽，名攝受因。即彼種子望所生芽，名生起因。芽、莖、葉等展轉相續，望彼稼穡若成、若熟，為引發因。
items.en: Depending on hunger and thirst, the body becomes weakened and unwell ... because each crop has its own distinct seed, various crops arise with their own distinct character — this very seed, with respect to the crop, is called the cause of distant attraction. Soil, rain, and similar conditions, able to produce a sprout, are called the cause of supportive embrace. That same seed, with respect to the sprout it produces, is called the cause of immediate arising. The sprout, stem, and leaves continuing on in succession, with respect to the crop's own eventual completion and ripening, are called the cause of induced extension.

items.zh: 從大麥種生大麥芽、大麥苗稼，不生餘類。如是所餘，當知亦爾。即說彼為此定別因。即彼一切從觀待因至定別因，同為稼穡而得成熟，名同事因。非彼稼穡隨闕一因而得成熟，是故一切和合說為此同事因。霜雹災等諸障礙法，望彼滋稼為相違因。彼闕無障，是諸滋稼不相違因。
items.en: From a barley seed, a barley sprout and barley crop arise, never any other kind ... all of these, from the cause of dependence through the cause of determinate distinction, working together towards the crop's own maturing, are called the cause of shared activity ... frost, hail, and similar calamities, with respect to the crop's own nourishment, are called the cause of opposition. Their absence, allowing that same nourishment to proceed, is the cause of non-opposition.

items.zh: 如是十因，於餘世間種種事物，隨其所應，當知廣如攝穀論說。

items.title: Section: The Ten Causes Applied to Suffering Itself — The Twelve Links of Dependent Origination

items.zh: 又於一切雜染緣起所有種種名想言說。謂無明、行、識、名色，廣說乃至老死、愁悲、憂苦、擾惱。即此望彼諸雜染法，為隨說因。如言無明緣行，乃至生緣老死。如是等類種種隨說。觀待境界所有愛味，於諸有支相續流轉，即彼望此諸雜染法，為觀待因。
items.en: Regarding all the defiled phenomena of dependent origination, every name and designation given to them — ignorance, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, and so on in detail up through old age, death, grief, sorrow, and affliction — these names, with respect to the defiled phenomena themselves, serve as the cause of expression. ... Craving for the pleasure found in experienced objects, driving the continued cycling through the links of existence — this, with respect to these defiled phenomena, is the cause of dependence.

items.zh: 於現法中，無明等法所有已生已長種子，今此種子，望於餘生生老死等，為牽引因。近不善士、聞不正法、非理作意，及先串習所引勢力生無明等，名攝受因。
items.en: In this very life, the seeds of ignorance and the other links, already arisen and already grown — these seeds, with respect to the old age and death of a future life, serve as the cause of distant attraction. Keeping company with the unwholesome, hearing incorrect teachings, careless attention, and the accumulated force of past habituation, all giving rise to ignorance — this is called the cause of supportive embrace.

items.zh: 無明等法各別種子，名生起因。
從無明支乃至有支，展轉引發後後相續，望於餘生生老死等，為引發因。餘無明支及自種子，乃至有支，能生那洛迦；餘無明支及自種子，乃至有支，能生傍生、餓鬼、人、天，當知亦爾。
items.en: From the link of ignorance through the link of becoming, each inducing the next in unbroken succession — this, with respect to the old age and death of a future life, is the cause of induced extension. One version of ignorance and its own seeds, through the link of becoming, is able to produce a hell-rebirth; another version of ignorance and its own seeds, through the link of becoming, is able to produce rebirth as an animal, a hungry ghost, a human, or a god — it should be understood to work the same way in each case.

items.zh: 即此望彼諸雜染法，名定別因。即彼一切從觀待因至定別因，名同事因。

items.title: Section: Completing the Application to Suffering, and the Mirror-Image Application to Liberation

items.zh: 此雜染法相違因者，謂出世間種姓具足，值佛出世演說正法，親近善士，聽聞正法，如理作意，法隨法行，及與一切菩提分法。
items.en: What opposes these defiled phenomena is: possessing the complete lineage for transcending the world, encountering a buddha's own teaching, keeping company with genuine teachers, hearing the true teaching, attending to it correctly, practising in accordance with it, and cultivating every factor of awakening.

items.zh: 即如所說種種善法若闕、若離，是雜染法不相違因。如是十因，應知能起一切有情一切雜染。

又於一切清淨品法及滅涅槃所有種種名想言說，即此望彼諸清淨法，為隨說因。如言：念住、正斷，乃至八聖道支；無明滅故行滅，廣說乃至生滅故老死滅。如是等類種種隨說。觀待諸行多過患故，樂求清淨、攝受清淨、成滿清淨，彼望於此為觀待因。安住種姓補特伽羅，種姓具足，能為上首，證有餘依及無餘依二涅槃界，彼望清淨，為牽引因。親近善士、聽聞正法、如理作意，及先所作諸根成熟，名攝受因。種姓所攝一切無漏菩提分法所有種子，望彼一切菩提分法，為生起因。即自種子所生一切菩提分法，漸次能證若有餘依、若無餘依二涅槃界，名引發因。聲聞種姓，以聲聞乘能般涅槃；獨覺種姓，以獨覺乘能般涅槃；大乘種姓，以無上乘能般涅槃；彼望清淨，為定別因。若清淨品觀待因乃至定別因，彼望清淨，為同事因。種姓不具足，不值佛出世，生諸無暇處，不親近善士，不聽聞正法，不如理作意，數習諸邪行，彼望清淨，為相違因。此相違因若闕、若離，是名清淨不相違因。
items.en: Regarding every pure phenomenon and cessation itself — nirvāṇa — every name and designation given to them serves, with respect to these pure phenomena, as the cause of expression. ... Depending on the many flaws inherent in conditioned existence, one comes to seek, embrace, and bring to fulfilment genuine purity — this, with respect to purity, is the cause of dependence.

items.zh: 若雜染品諸相違因，當知即是清淨法因；若清淨品諸相違因，當知即是雜染法因。如是現有雜染十因、清淨十因，過去、未來曾當染淨皆亦如是。一切唯有如是十因，除此無有若過若增。
items.en: Whatever opposes defiled phenomena should be understood as precisely the cause of pure phenomena; whatever opposes pure phenomena should be understood as precisely the cause of defiled phenomena. Just as there are, in the present, these ten causes of defilement and ten causes of purity, so too in the past and future. There are only ever these ten causes — nothing beyond them, and nothing more to add.

blocks.text: The ten causes illustrated twice: with a crop of barley, and with the twelve links of dependent origination, then reversed for liberation.

"The names given to crops (barley, wheat, rice, sesame) are the cause of expression." "Depending on hunger and thirst, the body becomes weak; depending on that, one seeks grain": dependence. Each crop's own seed is its distant attraction; soil, water, and warmth are supportive embrace; "from a barley seed a barley sprout arises, never any other kind": determinate distinction. Hail and drought are opposition; their absence, non-opposition.

"Ignorance, formations, consciousness, name-and-form, through old age and death": the names are the cause of expression. "In this very life, the seeds of ignorance and the other links, already grown, are the cause of distant attraction for the old age and death of a future life." "Keeping company with the unwholesome, hearing incorrect teachings, careless attention, and past habit" are supportive conditions.
"Possessing the lineage for transcending the world, encountering a Buddha's teaching, keeping company with genuine teachers, hearing the true teaching, attending wisely."

For pure phenomena and nirvāṇa, the same ten causes apply in reverse. "Depending on the many flaws of conditioned existence, one comes to seek liberation." "Whatever opposes defiled phenomena is the cause of pure phenomena; whatever opposes pure phenomena, the cause of defiled."

This is the treatise's theory of causation in a single image: the same analysis explains how a crop grows, how suffering continues, and how liberation is reached. Nothing happens without causes, and causes can be changed.

quiz.q: Defilement's supportive cause: "bad company, wrong teaching, careless attention." What does Master Cháng Bǎi say?
options: keeping bad teachers, hearing wrong views, and attending carelessly
quiz.why: "Keeping company with the unwholesome, hearing incorrect teachings, careless attention, and the accumulated force of past habituation, all giving rise to ignorance — this is called the cause of supportive embrace." Master Cháng Bǎi: keeping close to bad spiritual friends, hearing incorrect teachings of wrong views, and attending improperly.

quiz.q: Purity's cause of dependence: "depending on the many flaws of conditioned existence, one seeks purity." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say?
options: without feeling samsara as suffering, one can't study the noble path
quiz.why: "Depending on the many flaws inherent in conditioned existence, one comes to seek, embrace, and bring to fulfilment genuine purity — this, with respect to purity, is the cause of dependence." Venerable Miào Jìng: so if you don't feel that birth-and-death is suffering, you can't study the noble path.
